description: Create, change, delete or load cross-reference formats and their building blocks: paragraph text or number, page or chapter number, file or bookmark name, custom text, each with an optional character style (Hyperlinks panel menu > Define Cross-Reference Formats, Load Cross-Reference Formats).

blocks.description: create, edit: the format's building blocks in order (edit replaces them all), e.g. [{type:"custom_text",text:"see page "},{type:"page_number"}]

characterStyle.description: create, edit: character style for the whole cross-reference

filePath.description: load: an InDesign document to load formats from

name: manage_cross_reference_formats
title: Manage Cross Reference Formats
